name: Iris Aperture
author: E. T. Carter
description: A mechanical-diaphragm iris filling the frame: hard straight-edged camera blades overlap into a spiralling polygon and open and close on a slow breath. The leading edges form an N-gon aperture at the centre, the dark protagonist; each blade face is a faintly graded metal leaf with a luminous machined edge where it laps the next, colour flowing through the palette by angle as a cool metallic wash.

params.label: Blades
params.effect: Number of diaphragm blades; fewer gives a chunky few-sided aperture, more a finely faceted near-circular iris.

params.label: Aperture
params.effect: Mean radius of the central opening around which the blades breathe open and closed.

params.label: Breath speed
params.effect: Rate at which the diaphragm opens and closes; minimum is a near-minute cycle, maximum a slow visible iris.

params.label: Overlap
params.effect: How far each blade laps over the next; 0 gives a symmetric polygon, 1 a strongly spiralled diaphragm.
